intro: The long participle accompanies a name and agrees with it in gender, number and case: новый закон, принятый парламентом.

bloques.titulo: The long participle accompanies a name and agrees with it in gender, number and case: новый закон, принятый парламентом.
texto: The long participle accompanies a name and agrees with it in gender, number and case: новый закон, принятый парламентом.
It retains the verb regime: говорить о законе, принятом парламентом; it also observes the termination of the adjective.

bloques.pregunta: What complete form is о проекте (одобрить)?

opciones.explicacion: После о is used prepositional masculine singular: одобренном.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
Check which word rules the case or the structure.
